name: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
body: “Curiosity is the secret sauce to science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM)."

name: Rakesh Jhunjhunwala
body: "The purpose of Agastya, in my opinion, is not to teach science but to arouse curiosity through the medium of science. When the child gets curious, he wants to learn."

name: AM Naik
body: "When Ramji explained the van [Mobile Science Lab] to me, I said I would buy it and if it was any good, I would get L&T to buy it for every location. I felt it was good, so we now have 11 or 12 mobile labs."

name: Tadashi Tokieda
body: "Agastya is managing to expand in a macro way, but within the micro level. This is mezzo."

name: AS Kiran Kumar
body: "Agastya found the formula needed to ignite the child's mind, to help the child explore the process of comprehension and allow the child to develop the ability to use such learning to creatively solve problems."
foot1: Former Chairman, Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)

name: Arundhati Bhattacharya
body: "A truly remarkable story. Agastya's journey is one we can all learn from – its mission is one we should all try and be a part of."
foot1: Chairperson and CEO, Salesforce India Former Chairperson, State Bank of India

name: NR Narayana Murthy
body: "I think the beauty of Agastya has been to leverage the power of experimentation to communicate scientific ideas. It creates the foundation to enhance the curiosity of children."

name: Hayagreeva "Huggy" Rao
body: "What we need in society is more curiosity — the foundation of creativity, of searching and questioning."

name: TVSN Prasad
body: "Agastya's noble and transformative work will go in the annals of history as a spectacular yet unassuming contribution for generations to come."
foot1: Former Chief Secretary, Government of Haryana
